data.title: Opposition insight for Sassuolo-Milan: Form, injuries, predicted XI and more
data.content:
In the most recent game, a howler from Muric and a penalty given away allowed Monza to clinch a 2-1 win, even if Sassuolo came close by hitting the post at the end. It was actually Monza’s first win of the season, so unlike Milan, the break perhaps came at a good time for Aquilani’s side.

Predicted Sassuolo XI (4-3-3): Muric; Cinquegrano, Caleta-Car, Leysen, Doig; Adzic, Matic, Thorstvedt; Berardi, Esposito, Lauriente. [...] Aquilani is the head coach of the Neroverdi and with seven points so far, it has been a decent start to his new gig. Whether he can come back to haunt his former side, having played for Milan in the 2011-12 season, remains to be seen.
